target: Primitive-only finite neural training budgets for full recursive-entropic policy accuracy
primary_estimand: Deterministic certification success, actual training/check counts, and primitive real-arithmetic iteration bounds over the full declared catalogue. Clocks describe the executed machine and are not population expected runtimes.
development_disclosure: Before this freeze, allocation-only pilots evaluated horizons 8,16,24,32, dimensions 2,10,50 and risk levels 0,2,4. One dimension-10, eight-date anchor solve at theta=40 and seed=2901 was a development test. Unit tests use dimension at most 3 and horizon at most 5. No result from these pilots enters the primary catalogue or its clocks.
freeze: Scientific source, this protocol, independent verifier identity, method order and failure rules are committed before any primary fit. Local execution must state the source-freeze SHA and verify every frozen source hash.
order: Dimension, regime, risk, seed; alternate the two method orders in successive paired cells. Structural repetitions share no neural fitted object.
failure_rule: One capped attempt per service. Preserve all generated candidates before final verification, every unmet training threshold and every exception. No tolerance change, successful-subset selection, unrecorded rescue or overwrite.
information: Both generators receive the same analytic Gaussian primitives. NBO evaluates only its own finalized future; the structural optimum is not a fitting label, planning input or verifier input.
cost: Primitive initialization, allocation, all fitting and Gram checks, all actor solves, candidate serialization and durable write, independent full-policy verification, and durable attempt write. The closing service ledger and common imports/aggregation are separately accounted whole-job overhead. Operation counts are algebraic counters, not measured hardware instructions.
scope: Continuous Gaussian shocks, all real states and vector actions, all adapted finite-recursive-cost comparison policies, with all future controls reoptimized separately in every regime. The implementation action-error contract is explicit. The study is not empirical calibration, a continuous-time transfer certificate, or a prior assertion of neural cost dominance. Earlier failed checks and competing conventional methods remain in the evidence companion.
